package circuitbreaker

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"math"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/prometheus/client_golang/prometheus"
	dto "github.com/prometheus/client_model/go"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

func TestNativeSignedAndWrappingOracle(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		window   time.Duration
		qps      uint32
		expected StateType
	}{
		{2 * time.Second, 1 << 31, StateOpen},
		{-time.Second, 1, StateClosed},
		{-500 * time.Millisecond, 1, StateOpen},
		{time.Duration(math.MinInt64), 0, StateOpen},
		{time.Duration(math.MaxInt64), 0, StateClosed},
	} {
		t.Run(fmt.Sprint(tc.window), func(t *testing.T) {
			st := settings
			st.ErrorRateWindow = tc.window
			st.MinQPSForOpen = tc.qps
			st.CoolDownInterval = time.Duration(math.MinInt64)
			cb := NewCircuitBreaker(t.Name(), st)
			cb.state.failureCount = 1
			if tc.window == 2*time.Second {
				cb.state.end = time.Now().Add(-1)
			}
			err := cb.Execute(func() (Overloading, error) { return No, nil })
			require.Equal(t, tc.expected, cb.state.stateType)
			require.Equal(t, tc.expected == StateOpen, err != nil)
			if tc.expected == StateOpen {
				require.NoError(t, cb.Execute(func() (Overloading, error) { return No, nil }))
				require.Equal(t, StateHalfOpen, cb.state.stateType)
			}
		})
	}
	cb := NewCircuitBreaker(t.Name(), settings)
	cb.state.successCount = math.MaxUint32
	require.NoError(t, cb.Execute(func() (Overloading, error) { return No, nil }))
	require.Zero(t, cb.state.successCount)
	cb.state.failureCount = math.MaxUint32
	require.NoError(t, cb.Execute(func() (Overloading, error) { return Yes, nil }))
	require.Zero(t, cb.state.failureCount)
	cb.config.MinQPSForOpen = 0
	cb.state.failureCount = 1 << 30
	cb.state.end = time.Now().Add(-1)
	require.NoError(t, cb.Execute(func() (Overloading, error) { return No, nil }))
	require.Equal(t, StateClosed, cb.state.stateType)
	cb.state.failureCount = math.MaxUint32
	cb.state.successCount = 1
	cb.state.end = time.Now().Add(-1)
	require.NoError(t, cb.Execute(func() (Overloading, error) { return No, nil }))
}

func TestNativePanicAndCancellationOracle(t *testing.T) {
	cb := NewCircuitBreaker(t.Name(), settings)
	payload := errors.New("original panic")
	func() {
		defer func() { require.Same(t, payload, recover()) }()
		_ = cb.Execute(func() (Overloading, error) { panic(payload) })
	}()
	count := func(c prometheus.Counter) float64 {
		m := &dto.Metric{}
		require.NoError(t, c.Write(m))
		return m.GetCounter().GetValue()
	}
	require.Equal(t, float64(1), count(cb.overloadCounter))
	require.Zero(t, count(cb.errorCounter))
	require.Equal(t, context.Canceled, cb.Execute(func() (Overloading, error) { return No, context.Canceled }))
	require.Equal(t, float64(1), count(cb.successCounter))
	require.Equal(t, float64(1), count(cb.errorCounter))
	require.Nil(t, FromContext(nil))
	ctx := context.Background()
	require.Nil(t, FromContext(context.WithValue(ctx, CircuitBreakerKey, 42)))
	require.Same(t, cb, FromContext(WithCircuitBreaker(ctx, cb)))
	require.Nil(t, FromContext(WithCircuitBreaker(ctx, nil)))
	require.Equal(t, "unknown state: -42", StateType(-42).String())
}
